{{Quote|Who's that? Who's there?|Unidentified male Twi'lek Pop-Dog|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]]. In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was stationed at [[Glitterby Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] and encountered [[Bhindi Drayson]] and [[Jesmin Tainer]], members of the Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], after entering one of the base's storage rooms. Preoccupied with his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], he failed to notice the two Wraiths before the room was plunged into darkness when the door behind him slid shut. Before he could reopen the door, Tainer attacked him and attempted to place him into a choke hold, but was unable to do so because one of his [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] got in the way. As they struggled, Drayson [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] him in the chest with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Tainer then tied him up before the Wraiths continued their [[Firefight at Glitterby Base|mission]].<ref name="MK" />
